desiredFields.description:
Snap anything you see around you and it becomes a word card in the language you're learning. Supports Taiwanese Mandarin, English and Japanese.

■ Snap and collect
・Suggests words for what's in your photo and adds them to your collection with reading and meaning
・Cuts out the object as a sticker, and keeps where and when you caught it, plus a short note

■ Look things up
・Scan: point the camera at signs and menus to look them up
・Look up words by voice
・Common situations, example phrases and pronunciation audio

■ Remember
・Review quizzes (4 choices) paced to how well you know each word
・Write a diary and put the words you collected to use

■ One collection everywhere
Use the same account as the web version (catchwords.lovable.app); your words are the same on both.

Photos, words and text are analyzed with a third-party AI service. The app asks for your consent before anything is sent.

Privacy Policy: https://catchwords.lovable.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://catchwords.lovable.app/terms

desiredFields.description:
只要拍下街上看到的東西，就會變成你正在學的語言的單字卡。支援台灣華語、英語、日語。

■ 拍照收集
・從照片中的物品提出單字候選，加上讀音和意思收進圖鑑
・把拍到的物品去背做成貼紙，還能記下拍攝地點、日期和一句筆記

■ 查詢
・「掃描」：把相機對準招牌或菜單即可查詢
・也可以用語音查單字
・常用場景、用法例句、發音朗讀

■ 記住
・依熟悉程度出題的複習（四選一）
・寫日記，用用看收集到的單字

■ 到哪裡都是同一本圖鑑
可使用與網頁版（catchwords.lovable.app）相同的帳號，收集的單字兩邊都一樣。

照片、單字和文字的分析會使用外部的 AI 服務。傳送前會在 App 內徵求你的同意。

隱私權政策：https://catchwords.lovable.app/privacy
使用條款：https://catchwords.lovable.app/terms
